links.outcome: Expert-rated quality (EA-DISCERN total) of retrieval-supported vs ungrounded generative LLM answers to OB/GYN questions
links.effect: OpenEvidence total 54.0 ± 2.3 vs Gemini 50.3 ± 2.4 and ChatGPT 48.7 ± 2.4 (p < 0.001); higher accuracy, guideline consistency, completeness, transparency, reliability. Generative models scored higher on fluency and readability.
links.quote: OpenEvidence provided more guideline-aligned and transparent responses, whereas ChatGPT and Gemini were generally more fluent and readable.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the clinical accuracy and quality of three LLM/AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, and OpenEvidence) using 24 expert-rated clinical decision scenarios without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
